 Dated this the 10th day of February, 2025  ORDER
Petitioner is the accused in Sessions Case No.421/2024 of Fast Track Special Court, Koyilandi.
Petitioner is in custody from 10.01.2024.

The offences alleged against the petitioner and others are under Sections 376(3), 376-DA, 376(2)(n), 363, 366, 366-A, 342, 354-A (2) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(a), r/w 4(2) and 5(g) & (1) r/w 6(1) of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO Act).

sentences.text: It is submitted that the second accused is already released on bail.
It is also submitted that the victim in this case is already examined before the trial court and only official witnesses and other formal witnesses are to be examined.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner can file a fresh bail application before the trial court and if the main witnesses are examined, the learned Sessions Judge will consider the bail application and pass appropriate orders in 2025:KER:19990 BAIL APPL. NO.8367 OF 2024 that bail application, if such a bail application is filed within two weeks.
With the above observation, this bail application is disposed of.
